records.query: Apple 最近有什麼跟 Siri 有關的法律訴訟或和解消息？
records.answer:
Apple 最近同意以最高 2.5 億美元（約 2.5 億美元）和解一起指稱其在 Siri 人工智慧功能上誤導消費者的訴訟，受惠者每部 iPhone 最多可獲得 $95 的賠償金額【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  

- 這起訴訟指控 Apple 在行銷「Enhanced Siri」功能時，宣稱的 AI 功能尚未實際推出，導致消費者基於錯誤廣告購買 iPhone【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 和解金額上限為 2.5 億美元，屬於 Apple 歷史上規模最大的和解之一【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 和解適用於購買 iPhone 16、iPhone 15 Pro 或 iPhone 15 Pro Max，且購買期間為 2024 年 6 月 10 日至 2025 年 3 月 29 日的消費者，約有 3,700 萬部 iPhone 符合資格【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 符合資格的用戶最初將收到每部設備 $25 的賠償，最終金額視申請情況而定，最高不超過 $95【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- Apple 表示已解決此事，以便專注於「提供最創新的產品與服務」【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。

iPhone owners could receive up to $95 under a proposed $250 million settlement resolving claims that Apple misled customers about Siri's artificial intelligence features, according to a recent court filing. The class-action lawsuit, filed in federal court in the Northern District of California on behalf of U.S. consumers, claims that Apple deceived customers by marketing "Enhanced Siri features" that did not yet exist, leading them to buy iPhones based on false advertising. The plaintiffs are seeking a $250 million settlement payment, according to a recent court filing. If approved by a judge, it could rank among the largest settlements involving Apple. "Apple has reached a settlement to resolve claims related to the availability of two additional features," an Apple spokesperson said in an email to CBS News. "We resolved this matter to stay focused on doing what we do best, delivering the most innovative products and services to our users."
Clarkson Law Firm, a public interest law firm that filed the original lawsuit against Apple, said in a statement on Wednesday that the settlement would provide "timely relief to tens of millions of consumers nationwide."
Here's what to know about the recent settlement. Am I eligible? The settlement covers people who purchased an iPhone 16 model, iPhone 15 Pro or iPhone 15 Pro Max between June 10, 2024, and March 29, 2025. Approximately 37 million iPhone owners are eligible, according to the court filing. Customers will be notified by either email or mail if they can file a claim. An online social media campaign will also provide information about the settlement website and who is eligible, according to the court filing. How much money could I get? Eligible customers will initially receive $25 per device. Depending on how many claims are submitted and other determining factors, the final payment may increase or decrease, but it will not exceed $95 per device, according to the court filing

After two years of delays, Apple's (
AAPL
) reinvented Siri, Siri AI,
appears ready for primetime
. The company unveiled the AI-powered version of its assistant at its Worldwide Developers Conference in Cupertino, Calif., on Monday, saying it will launch, albeit as a beta, later this year. The update is designed to transform Siri from a glorified kitchen timer to a
digital helper for the AI age
. Apple said Siri AI will be able to pull context from your apps, allowing you to, say, ask it the name of a podcast your sister recommended via text and have it presented to you without opening any separate apps or services. The idea is for Siri AI to recognize what you want, when you want it, and surface it, whether it's content on your device or from the web. It's more or less what Apple promised when it showed off its AI-enhanced Siri and Apple Intelligence at WWDC 2024. And in early demos, Siri AI, which rides on Apple Intelligence, appears to deliver on Apple's initial vision for its reimagined Siri. And it's thanks, at least in part, to Google (
GOOG
,
GOOGL
). Siri gets Google brains
In January, Apple and Google signed an agreement for Apple to use the search giant's Gemini models to power its improved Siri. That gave Apple the high-powered AI models it needed to move Siri AI forward, after its own models fell short,
Bloomberg's Mark Gurman previously reported
. During a question and answer session following Apple's WWDC keynote, senior vice president of software engineering Craig Federighi explained how Apple uses Google's models to give Siri AI its smarts. The software chief was sure to point out that Siri AI isn't just a rebranded version of Google's own Gemini assistant. Federighi explained how the Gemini assistant uses Google's Gemini models, including Gemini Flash-Lite, Gemini Flash, Gemini Pro, and its Gemini Image models. When it comes to grounding those models in world knowledge, he said, Gemini takes advantage of Google Search. Apple, Federighi said, uses none of those things. "We use none of the models that Google deploys to their customers, nor do we use the infrastructure and means by which they employ models to their customers," he explained.

records.query: NVIDIA 最近跟 IREN 之間有什麼合作的新聞？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 最近與 IREN 簽署了一系列大型 AI 基礎設施合作協議，包括一份價值 **34 億美元** 的五年 AI Cloud 合約，以及一項 **21 億美元** 的投資承諾，這些安排會隨著 GPU 部署而逐步生效【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】【NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0】。  

- IREN 宣布與 NVIDIA 簽訂 **34 億美元** 的五年 AI Cloud 合約，合約金額會在 GPU 部署完成後逐步解鎖，並以 Air‑cooled Blackwell GPU 為主【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。  
- 同時，NVIDIA 為 IREN 提供 **21 億美元** 的投資權利，該投資僅在 NVIDIA GPU 基礎設施部署至 IREN 各站點後才會全部生效，完整投資額會在部署 **600,000 台 GPU** 後全部解鎖【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 投資權利還包括 NVIDIA 可在五年內以每股 **$70** 的價格購買最多 **0.3 億** 普通股，若全部行使，最高可達 **21 億美元** 的潛在投資額【NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 合作的技術規模包括在 IREN 全球平台上部署最高 **5 GW** 的 NVIDIA HGX‑aligned AI 基礎設施，並在 2026 年目標建置 **480 MW**、**150,000 台 GPU**，2027 年擴展至 **1,210 MW**【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 具體部署項目之一是位於 Childress 的 **60 MW** 空冷 Blackwell GPU 設備，該部分與 AI Cloud 合約相關，並已產生約 **7 億美元** 的 ARR（年度經常性收入）【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- IREN 亦在 2026 年計畫將 **5 GW** 的 NVIDIA HGX‑aligned AI 基礎設施與其已確保的電力資源相結合，以滿足日益增長的 AI 計算需求【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。  

總結來說，NVIDIA 與 IREN 的最新合作聚焦於大型 AI Cloud 合約、巨額投資承諾以及大規模 GPU 部署，旨在將 IREN 的電力與數據中心資產轉化為高效的 AI 計算供應。

China market for Nvidia AI chips to open 'over time': Huang
AFP
Tue, May 19, 2026 at 11:02 AM GMT+8
2 min read
NVDA
-1.33%
Nvidia boss Jensen Huang expects China to eventually open its market to high-end US chips that can train and run artificial intelligence systems. But he did not discuss sales of the powerful H200 model with top officials in Beijing, the businessman told Bloomberg Television in an interview broadcast Monday. Huang travelled to the country last week with US President Donald Trump, who met Chinese President Xi Jinping. The superpowers are in a fierce race for AI supremacy, and the H200 chip had until recently been barred from sale in China by Washington over national security concerns. However, there is no sign that Chinese tech companies are buying them, as Beijing ramps up domestic chip development in a bid to challenge US dominance in the key sector. "H200s are licensed to sell to China.

[NVDA] But the Chinese government has to decide how much of their local market do they want to protect," Huang said. "My sense is that over time the market will open," added Huang, CEO of Nvidia -- the world's most valuable company, due to huge demand for its AI hardware. Trump said in December he had reached an agreement with Xi to ease the restrictions on H200 chips, a move some US lawmakers have warned could help the Chinese military. Nvidia's most top-of-the-range offerings, the Blackwell and forthcoming Rubin series, remain banned for sale in China. Xi told a delegation of US business executives on Thursday that China would "open wider" to the world.

- **AMD** – Nvidia is also “facing ever‑increasing competition from AMD, which will launch a competing rack‑scale server system later this year” [Reference 1: NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4].  
- **Amazon (AMZN) and Google (GOOG/GOOGL)** – Both cloud giants are “offering their AI chips to third‑party customers,” and Amazon’s own chip business is reported to have “an annual revenue run rate of more than 200 億美元 and is growing at triple‑digit percentages year over year” [Reference 1: NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4].  
- **Market focus on AI trade** – Nvidia’s earnings are described as “a barometer of artificial intelligence trade” and the AI boom is highlighted as a “key market driver” for semiconductor firms this earnings season [Reference 2: NVDA_News_20260519_02.txt, chunk #0; Reference 2: NVDA_News_20260519_02.txt, chunk #1].  

Together, these points illustrate that the pre‑earnings narrative centers on intensifying chip‑level rivalry and the pivotal role Nvidia plays in gauging the health of the rapidly expanding AI‑chip market.

records.query: NVIDIA 最新財報顯示的營收成長速度如何？加上新聞中它與 IREN 最新的 AI 雲端合作案，這反映出公司在資料中心布局上的哪些具體進展？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 在最新的財季（截至 2026 年 4 月 26 日的第一季）營收從去年同季的 **440.62 億美元** 增至 **816.15 億美元**，同比增長約 **85 %**【NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #14】。  

這一強勁的營收增長同時伴隨著與 IREN 的最新 AI 雲端合作，具體體現在以下資料中心布局的進展：

* **5 GW 的 NVIDIA‑aligned AI 基礎設施**：IREN 宣布與 NVIDIA 簽訂了五千兆瓦（5 GW）戰略合作，旨在於其全球資料中心平台部署 NVIDIA HGX 系列設備【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】；同樣在 CryptoProwl 報導中提到此 5 GW 合作【NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0】。  
* **21 億美元 投資權利**：該合作允許 NVIDIA 以每股 $70 的價格購買最高 3,000 萬股普通股，若全部行使將形成最高 **21 億美元** 的潛在投資，且投資金額會隨 GPU 基礎設施部署而逐步解鎖【NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0】；此結構亦在 IREN 的問答環節中被說明【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
* **34 億美元 AI Cloud 合約**：IREN 與 NVIDIA 簽訂了為期五年的 **34 億美元** AI Cloud 合約，針對 Air‑cooled Blackwell GPU 的部署，首批 60 MW 會在 Childress 資料中心內實施【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。  
* **2026 年目標 480 MW、150,000 顆 GPU**：IREN 計畫在 2026 年完成 **480 MW** 的 AI Cloud 容量，並部署約 **150,000 顆 GPU**，以支撐其 ARR 從 31 億美元 提升至 37 億美元 的目標【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。  
* **2027 年擴展至 1,210 MW**：2027 年的規模將擴大至 **1,210 MW**，其中已在建的 730 MW 主要分布於加拿大不列顛哥倫比亞與德州的 Childress 以及 Sweetwater 兩大站點【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。  
* **300 MW Liquid‑cooled Childress 項目**：在 Childress，IREN 正在推進 **300 MW** 的液冷部署（Horizon 1‑4），使用 NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 伺服器，預計 Q3 交付給 Microsoft，全年完成其餘階段【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #5】。  
* **60 MW Air‑cooled Blackwell GPU**：除液冷外，IREN 亦在 Childress 以 **60 MW** 的空冷方式部署 Blackwell GPU，相關 ARR 約為 **7 億美元**，屬於已簽約的 34 億美元 合約的一部分【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #5】。  
* **AI Cloud 服務收入**：在 IREN 2023 年第三季，AI Cloud 相關收入已達 **0.336 億美元**，顯示該業務正快速成長【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。  
* **已簽約的 5 GW 電力供應**：IREN 在本季已將受保電力提升至 **5 GW**，全部已簽約，為未來 AI 基礎設施提供充足電力基礎【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。  

綜合以上，NVIDIA 的營收高速成長與 IREN 的大規模 AI 雲端合作共同顯示，NVIDIA 正透過資本投入、GPU 供應與長期合約，推動全球超過 5 GW 的 AI 計算基礎設施建設，並在 2026‑2027 年間快速擴充液冷與空冷資料中心容量，鞏固其在高效能資料中心市場的領導地位。

By: CryptoProwl
IREN Limited (NASDAQ:
$IREN
) shares jumped in after-hours trading on Thursday after the company announced a new Nvidia (NASDAQ:
$NVDA
) partnership that gives its AI infrastructure pivot a much larger public-market signal. The stock rose 27% to $72.28 after closing at $56.85, before pulling back to $69.45 at press time, still up more than 21%. The rally followed IREN’s disclosure of a five-gigawatt strategic partnership with Nvidia tied to the deployment of AI infrastructure across its global data center pipeline. Under the agreement, IREN issued Nvidia a five-year right to purchase up to 30 million ordinary shares at $70 per share. If fully exercised, the right would represent up to $2.1 billion of potential investment, subject to conditions including regulatory limits. The partnership is expected to focus on Nvidia-aligned DSX AI factory infrastructure, with future deployments centred around IREN’s two-gigawatt Sweetwater campus in Texas. IREN also announced a separate five-year, $3.4 billion AI Cloud contract with Nvidia for air-cooled Blackwell GPUs, with deployment expected within 60 megawatts of existing data centers at Childress and a targeted ramp beginning in early 2027. The update pushes IREN further away from the pure bitcoin-mining identity it carried when it operated as Iris Energy.

Apple said Siri AI will be able to pull context from your apps, allowing you to, say, ask it the name of a podcast your sister recommended via text and have it presented to you without opening any separate apps or services. The idea is for Siri AI to recognize what you want, when you want it, and surface it, whether it's content on your device or from the web. It's more or less what Apple promised when it showed off its AI-enhanced Siri and Apple Intelligence at WWDC 2024. Cost of sales primarily consists of the purchase price of consumer products, inbound and outbound shipping costs, including costs related to sortation and delivery centers and where we are the transportation service provider, and digital media content costs where we record revenue gross, including video and music. Shipping costs to receive products from our suppliers are included in our inventory and recognized as cost of sales upon sale of products to our customers. We expect our cost of shipping to continue to increase to the extent our customers accept and use our shipping offers at an increasing rate, we use more expensive shipping methods, and we offer additional services. We seek to mitigate costs of shipping over time in part through achieving higher sales volumes, optimizing our fulfillment network, negotiating better terms with our suppliers, and achieving better operating efficiencies. Costs to operate our AWS segment are primarily classified as “Technology and infrastructure” as we leverage a shared infrastructure that supports both our internal technology requirements and external sales to AWS customers. Fulfillment

Fulfillment costs primarily consist of those costs incurred in operating and staffing our North America and International fulfillment centers, physical stores, and customer service centers and payment processing costs. While AWS payment processing and related transaction costs are included in “Fulfillment,” AWS costs are primarily classified as “Technology and infrastructure.” Fulfillment costs as a percentage of net sales may vary due to several factors, such as payment processing and related transaction costs, our level of productivity and accuracy, changes in volume, size, and weight of units received and fulfilled, the extent to which third-party sellers utilize Fulfillment by Amazon services, timing of fulfillment network and physical store expansion, the extent we utilize fulfillment services provided by third parties, mix of products and services sold, and our ability to affect customer service contacts per unit by implementing improvements in our operations and enhancements to our customer self-service features. records.answer:
Tesla 的汽車業務毛利率在最新的財報中呈現「季季下跌、半年期上升」的分化走勢：在截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的三個月期間，汽車毛利率從 2025 年同季的 17.2% 降至 16.9%【TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77】；而在同樣結算日的六個月期間，汽車毛利率則從 2025 年的 16.8% 上升至 18.7%【TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77】。這顯示短期（季度）毛利率略有收縮，但在較長的半年度內毛利率已回升至更高水平。

同時，新聞報導指出「Magnificent Seven」科技股—including Tesla—自上週五以來全部下跌，顯示投資者正對整體科技板塊採取拋售姿態【NVDA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】；另一篇 JPMorgan 註記亦提到這些大型科技股正遭市場拋售【NVDA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #1】。雖然報導未提供 Tesla 股價的具體變動數字，但因 Tesla 被列入受跌勢影響的七大科技股，投資者情緒的負面轉變可能對其股價形成下行壓力。

- 汽車毛利率：三個月期從 17.2% 降至 16.9%，六個月期則從 16.8% 升至 18.7%。  
- 市場情緒：整體「Magnificent Seven」科技股的同步下跌（包括 Tesla）暗示近期 Tesla 股價可能承受負面市場情緒的壓力，儘管具體股價變化未在資料中披露。

records.query: NVIDIA 的核心技術護城河是什麼？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 的核心護城河在於它提供的完整、端到端的加速運算平台——從領先的 GPU、CPU、DPU 硬體，到 CUDA 與廣泛的 AI 軟體堆疊，再加上超過 0.075 億 開發者與數千家雲端服務供應商、學術機構與初創企業的生態系統，讓公司能在資料中心規模的 AI 基礎建設上保持獨占優勢。  

- **硬體領先**：NVIDIA 以 GPU 為核心，持續在 GPU、CPU（Grace）與 DPU（Mellanox 收購）三大 AI 處理單元上投入研發，並在 Blackwell 架構中實現「極致協同設計」——晶片、網路、系統、軟體與演算法全部共同優化，以支援數十萬顆 GPU 互聯成單一巨型電腦的資料中心規模需求【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  

- **軟體與開發平台**：CUDA 開發平台可在所有 NVIDIA GPU 上執行，並配套數百項領域專屬的軟體庫、框架、API 與 SDK，形成完整的軟體堆疊，讓開發者能快速部署 AI、資料分析、科學運算等高效能工作負載【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  

- **AI 端到端解決方案**：NVIDIA AI Enterprise 套件（含 NIM、NeMo、AI Blueprints）提供從模型訓練、微調、強化學習到安全部署的全流程工具，協助企業在自家加速硬體上建置生成式與代理式 AI 應用【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  

- **生態系統規模**：全球已有超過 0.075 億 開發者使用 CUDA 及其他 NVIDIA 軟體工具，並透過 Inception 計畫、Deep Learning Institute、與數千家大學及初創公司的合作，持續擴大平台的使用與創新動能【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  

- **全方位平台策略**：公司提供涵蓋資料中心基礎設施、開放模型、系統、嵌入式運算模組與軟體堆疊的完整平台，從資料中心 AI 訓練與推論到嵌入式自動駕駛與雲端遊戲服務（GeForce NOW）皆以同一套可程式化架構支撐【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26】。  

- **研發投入**：自成立以來已累計投入超過 767 億美元 於研發，確保硬體與軟體持續領先並創造新一代 AI 與圖形技術【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  

以上這些硬體、軟體、開發者生態與全方位平台的結合，構成了 NVIDIA 在加速運算與 AI 市場的核心技術護城河。

records.query: NVIDIA 如何用同一套底層架構同時佈局資料中心、遊戲、專業視覺化與車用市場？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 以同一套可程式化的 GPU 與 CUDA 軟體生態系，結合硬體、系統、軟體與服務，同步在資料中心、遊戲、專業視覺化與車用四大市場提供完整解決方案【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。

* **資料中心**：NVIDIA 的 Data Center 平台以高效能 GPU、CPU、NVLink 互連與完整的 AI/HPC 軟體堆疊（包括加速函式庫、模型與 SDK）組成，提供從雲端到邊緣的全方位運算與網路基礎建設【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #24】。  

* **遊戲**：GeForce RTX 系列 GPU 採用相同的 GPU 架構與 Tensor Core 技術，搭配 RTX 光線追蹤與 DLSS AI 超取樣，為桌面與筆電玩家帶來高畫質與高效能的遊戲體驗【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26】。  

* **專業視覺化**：RTX PRO GPU 同樣使用 Data Center 解決方案中採用的 Tensor Core 技術，讓 3D 設計與內容創作應用能在工作站上獲得 AI 加速與渲染效能【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26】。  

* **車用**：DRIVE Hyperion 平台結合 NVIDIA 的 AI 技術、CUDA 生態系與模組化軟體平台，提供從雲端到車內的完整自動駕駛堆疊，包括高效能 DRIVE AGX 硬體、車載作業系統與感測器套件【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26】。  

透過這套統一的底層架構，NVIDIA 能在不同垂直領域共享硬體基礎、軟體開發套件與生態系合作夥伴，形成跨市場的協同效應與規模優勢。

records.query: Microsoft 如何把 Copilot 整合進 Microsoft 365 的產品策略？
records.answer:
Microsoft 把 Copilot 作為 Microsoft 365 Commercial 套件的核心 AI 元件，與 Office、Windows、Enterprise Mobility + Security 以及其他雲端服務緊密結合，成為推動產品與收入成長的關鍵力量【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  

- 在 10‑K 中，Microsoft 365 Commercial 被描述為「AI‑powered business and productivity solutions platform」 ，其中明確列出 Microsoft 365 Copilot 與 Office、Windows 等一起構成平台，說明 Copilot 已經內嵌於整個生產力生態系統【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  
- 10‑Q 的指標說明中，Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud revenue growth 的定義包括「Microsoft 365 Copilot」的收入，表示 Copilot 的銷售與使用已被納入商業雲端收入衡量，成為評估 Microsoft 365 商業表現的指標之一【MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #103】。  
- 10‑K 2025 版的同一段落再次將 Copilot 列入 Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud revenue growth 的組成項目，強調它在產品組合與收入增長中的角色【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #142】。  

因此，Microsoft 的產品策略是把 Copilot 直接嵌入 Microsoft 365 Commercial 產品線，讓 AI 功能成為 Office、Windows、Power BI、Teams 等服務的共同增值層，並透過相應的雲端收入與使用者座位增長指標來追蹤其貢獻。

agentic_sub_queries: Microsoft 宣布將 Copilot 整合至 Microsoft 365 的具體內容是什麼？

records.query: Microsoft 如何靠 Windows 帶動雲端與 Copilot 相關服務的參與度？
records.answer:
Microsoft 通过把 Windows 商业版（包括 OEM 与本地 on‑premises 组件）整合进 Microsoft 365 商业套件，直接提升了云端服務與 Copilot 的使用率，使得雲端收入與整體產品收入均出現兩位數的增長。  

- 在截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的九個月期間，Microsoft 365 商業產品與雲端服務收入增加了 **$10.6 億**，其中 **產品收入增長 10%**，這一增長「受 Windows Commercial 本地‑on‑premises 組件的提升」所驅動【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #109】。  
- 同期，Microsoft 365 商業雲端收入 **增長 18%**（九個月）【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #109】與 **增長 19%**（九個月）【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #105】；增長的主要動力是「每位使用者收入提升」以及 **Microsoft 365 E5 與 Copilot** 帶來的額外使用量【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #109】。  
- 在 Microsoft 10‑K（FY 2025）中，雲端收入的度量明確將 **Windows Commercial 的雲端部分** 列入 Microsoft 365 商業雲端收入的計算範圍，顯示公司已將 Windows 產品與雲服務緊密捆綁，以監測其對雲端增長的貢獻【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #142】。  
- 同樣在 FY 2025，Microsoft 將 **Windows OEM 與 Devices** 的收入與其他 PC 市場驅動業務合併為單一增長指標，表明 Windows 硬體與授權收入被視為推動整體雲端與服務收入的關鍵組件【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #142】。  

綜合以上，Windows 商業版的本地授權與 OEM 銷售不僅直接提升了 Microsoft 365 產品收入，亦透過其在 Microsoft 365 商業雲端收入定義中的佔比，促成了雲端服務與 Copilot 使用量的顯著上升。

[MSFT] Microsoft Relationship Seen as Complementary
Asked about investor concerns over Microsoft concentration, Jiang said AvePoint has operated in the Microsoft ecosystem for more than 20 years but does not depend on Microsoft as a reseller. He said Microsoft does not resell AvePoint’s products, and AvePoint helps customers complete “last mile” adoption of workloads such as Purview, E5 and Copilot. Jiang said AvePoint is also active in the Google, Salesforce and AWS ecosystems as customers become increasingly multi-cloud. He said AvePoint is complementary to hyperscalers because it helps customers manage different license types and workloads across multiple platforms. On Microsoft 365 backup, Jiang said Microsoft Office Cloud has roughly 400 million to 500 million user seats, while AvePoint covers “tens of millions” of seats and is not yet at 100 million. He said the company still sees room for growth, while also incorporating Microsoft’s Backup Express snapshot capability into its own backup stack. Jiang said many customers use a mix of license levels, noting that E5 penetration remains below 20% and Copilot penetration is about 5%, according to his comments. He said AvePoint helps customers maximize existing investments rather than pushing them toward the highest-cost licenses. Multi-Cloud Expansion and SaaS Model
Jiang said AvePoint expects non-Microsoft revenue to rise to more than 30% of its mix as the company pursues its goal of reaching $1 billion in annual recurring revenue. He said non-Microsoft revenue is currently less than 10%. He said the company already has product coverage across ecosystems including Google, Salesforce, Atlassian, ServiceNow and AWS, but go-to-market development takes time because each ecosystem has different partners and channels. Jiang also highlighted AvePoint’s SaaS-heavy model. He said 88% of revenue is recurring and that AvePoint runs on hyperscaler infrastructure across GCP, Azure, AWS and U.S. government data centers. He said hyperscaler contracts help shield AvePoint from hardware supply-chain shocks and pricing volatility. “We are a true SaaS company that’s asset light,” Jiang said. Control Suite and AgentPulse
Kessinger asked Jiang to clarify AvePoint’s role in governance and security. Jiang said the company’s roots in enterprise content management mean it manages the lifecycle of unstructured data, from ingestion, migration, classification and tagging to backup, ransomware recovery and governance. Jiang said these capabilities are increasingly important in the AI era because AI can accelerate access and data-management problems. He said AvePoint competes across areas that had previously been separate, including migration, backup, governance and data security posture management. Jiang also discussed AvePoint AgentPulse, which he said became generally available in the first quarter after a preview late last year. records.query: Google 如何把 Gemini AI 整合進搜尋與其他產品生態系？
records.answer:
Google 透過在搜尋、YouTube、Google Workspace、Pixel 裝置以及企業服務等多個核心產品中嵌入 Gemini 系列大型語言模型，將 Gemini AI 完全整合進其生態系統，使 AI 功能遍佈數十億使用者的產品上【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。

- **搜尋與多媒體體驗**：Alphabet 在 10‑K 中說明，Gemini 3 是「最具智慧的 AI 模型」，具備先進的多模態理解與推理能力，已被嵌入 Google Search 以及 Gemini App，提升搜尋的視覺化與互動式使用者體驗【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
- **YouTube 及其他內容平台**：同段落指出，所有 15 個「半億使用者」的產品（其中包括 YouTube）均使用 Gemini 模型，讓影片推薦與內容生成受益於生成式 AI 的加持【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
- **Google Workspace（Gmail、Docs、Sheets 等）**：在 10‑Q 中提到「Gemini for Google Workspace」將 AI 代理人帶入 Gmail、Docs、Sheets 等工具，協助使用者撰寫、組織、視覺化與加速工作流程【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #71】。  
- **企業雲端與 AI 服務**：10‑K 內說明，Google Cloud 透過「Gemini Enterprise」提供團隊在安全平台上建立、分享與執行 AI 代理人，讓企業客戶能在雲端環境中直接使用 Gemini 的生成與推理能力【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】。  
- **Pixel 裝置與消費者服務**：在 10‑K 的「其他產品」說明中，Pixel 系列與 Google One 訂閱服務均提供「最先進的 Gemini 模型」存取權，將 AI 功能延伸至硬體與消費者訂閱產品【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #134】。  

綜合上述，Google 以全堆疊 AI 策略，從底層的 TPUs 與雲端基礎設施，到前端的搜尋、影片、辦公套件與硬體裝置，全面將 Gemini AI 融入產品與服務，實現「AI 於每個使用者、開發者與企業」的願景【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。

records.query: Meta 在 AI 與 Reality Labs 上的長期願景與投資方向是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 的長期願景是打造「下一代計算平台」——以 AI、可穿戴裝置、虛擬/增強實境 (VR/AR) 以及元宇宙生態系統為核心，最終實現能超越人類智慧的「超級智慧」[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

- **元宇宙與 Reality Labs 的戰略**：Meta 把「將元宇宙帶入生活」定位為長期、複雜且持續演進的計畫，投入 AI、可穿戴設備與新介面等領域，並預期需要大量基礎設施、隱私與安全投入以及與其他公司、開發者的合作[ META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #72]。同樣的說法也出現在 2025 年的 10‑K 中[ META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175]。

- **AI 投資方向**：Meta 正在全公司範圍內加大 AI 研發，涵蓋內容排序、廣告工具、生成式 AI 體驗以及「個人超級智慧」的開發；公司已開源 Llama 基礎模型，並計畫同時培訓開放與封閉模型[ META_10K_2025.html, chunk #135]。AI 投資被描述為「持續增加」的項目，且是推動計算需求擴張的主要動力[ META_10K_2025.html, chunk #135]。

- **Reality Labs 的資金配置**：在 2026 年，Meta 預計將 Reality Labs 營運費用的約 70% 用於可穿戴裝置（wearables）計畫，剩餘 30% 用於 VR 與 Horizon（元宇宙平台）[ META_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。

- **財務影響**：2025 年，Reality Labs 的投資減少了約 **191.9 億美元** 的整體營運利潤，且預期 2026 年的 Reality Labs 營運虧損將與 2025 年相似[ META_10K_2025.html, chunk #188]。

- **長期技術與基礎建設**：Meta 正自行建置資料中心與關鍵技術基礎設施，同時也依賴第三方供應，以支撐日益增長的 AI 計算需求；未來的硬體與軟體創新將持續驅動其計算需求擴大[ META_10K_2025.html, chunk #135]。

- **風險與不確定性**：Meta 承認若 Reality Labs 的研發與市場接受度未如預期，或在硬體互通性、法規、競爭等方面遭遇挑戰，可能對品牌、使用者基礎與財務表現產生負面影響[ META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #72]、[ META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175]。

綜合以上，Meta 的長期投資路線是：以 AI 為驅動、結合可穿戴與沉浸式硬體，持續投入 Reality Labs 以打造元宇宙平台，同時透過開源與自研的超大型 AI 模型追求「個人超級智慧」的遠景，儘管短期內此類投資已大幅壓縮營運利潤且伴隨高風險。

We believe the metaverse, an embodied internet where people have immersive experiences beyond two-dimensional screens, is the next evolution in social technology. In 2021, we announced a shift in our business and product strategy to focus on helping to bring the metaverse to life, and we are directing our efforts toward innovations in AI, wearables, and devices to help build next-generation interfaces. We expect this will be a complex, evolving, and long-term initiative that will involve the development of new and emerging technologies, continued investment in infrastructure as well as privacy, safety, and security efforts, and collaboration with other companies, developers, partners, and other participants. However, the metaverse may not develop in accordance with our expectations, and market acceptance of features, products, or services we build is uncertain. We regularly evaluate our product roadmaps and make significant changes as our understanding of the technological challenges and market landscape and our product ideas and designs evolve. In addition, we have relatively limited experience with consumer hardware products and virtual and augmented reality technology, which may enable other companies to compete more effectively than us. We may be unsuccessful in our research and product development efforts, including if we are unable to develop relationships with key participants in the metaverse or develop products that operate effectively with metaverse technologies, products, systems, networks, or standards. For example, some of our consumer hardware products depend on the ability to operate with third-party mobile platforms and these platforms do not necessarily provide our products with the same levels of interoperability that they provide to their own competing products. In addition, our Reality Labs efforts may also divert resources and management attention from other areas of our business. We expect to continue to make significant investments in virtual and augmented reality and other technologies to support these efforts, and our ability to support these efforts is dependent on generating sufficient profits from other areas of our business. In addition, as our Reality Labs efforts evolve, we may be subject to a variety of existing or new laws and regulations in the United States and international jurisdictions, including in the areas of privacy, safety, AI, competition, content regulation, medical devices, tariffs, export controls, consumer protection, and e-commerce, which may delay or impede the development of our products

[META 10-K period 2025] Item 1.Business 

Overview

Our mission is to build the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible. Our products enable people to connect and share through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality (VR) headsets, and AI glasses. We are innovating in artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to build transformative experiences and capabilities across our Family of Apps and new platforms, and to advance our vision to deliver personal superintelligence for everyone. We build technology that helps people connect and share, find and build communities, and grow businesses. We also help people discover and learn about what is going on in the world around them, enable people to share their experiences, ideas, photos, videos, and other content with audiences ranging from their closest family members and friends to the public at large, and stay connected everywhere by accessing our products. Meta is moving our offerings beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next computing platform. Our vision does not center on any single product, but rather an entire ecosystem of experiences, devices, and new technologies powered by AI. While the metaverse is in the very early stages of its development, we believe it will become the next computing platform and the future of social interaction. Across our work, we are innovating to build new experiences that help make our platform more social, useful, and immersive. Our AI investments support initiatives across our products and services, helping power the systems that rank content in our apps, our discovery engine that recommends relevant content, the tools advertisers use to reach customers, the development of new generative AI experiences, and the tools that make our product development more efficient and productive. We are also working to develop the next generation of AI models and advance our vision to build superintelligence, which we define as AI that surpasses human intelligence. Although it is inherently difficult to predict when superintelligence may be achieved, we are investing now because we believe this has the potential to begin a new era of individual empowerment, where people can direct superintelligence towards what they value in their own lives. Family of Apps Products

•Facebook. Facebook helps give people the power to build community and bring the world closer together. It's a place for people to share life's moments and discuss what's happening, nurture and build relationships, discover and connect to people with shared interests, and create economic opportunity. They can do this through Feed, Reels, Stories, Groups, Marketplace, and more. •Instagram. Instagram brings people closer to the people and things they love. Instagram Feed, Stories, Reels, Live, and messaging are places where people and creators can connect and express themselves through photos, video, and private messaging, and discover and shop from their favorite businesses. •Messenger. Messenger is a simple yet powerful messaging application for people to connect with friends, family, communities, and businesses across platforms and devices through text, audio, and video calls. •Meta AI. Meta AI is an assistant that's available across our apps, as a stand-alone app, on our AI glasses, and on the web. It's designed to help people learn, get things done, create content, and connect with others to make the most of every moment.

Historically, the increases in our computing needs have been driven by growth in our user base as well as engagement with products like video and VR. Our increased efforts toward building frontier AI models have driven a significant further expansion in our computing needs and we expect our computing needs to continue to expand as a result. We have designed and built our own data centers and key portions of our technical infrastructure, and a substantial portion of our technical infrastructure is also provided by third parties. Our ability to provide and continue to innovate our products and services depends on the continued availability of components, power, and network capacity. We make significant investments in technology both to improve our existing products and services and to develop new ones, as well as for our marketers and developers. We are also investing in protecting the security, privacy, and integrity of our platform by investing in both people and technology to strengthen our systems against abuse. Across all of these efforts, we are making significant investments in AI initiatives, including generative AI and superintelligence, to, among other things, recommend relevant content across our products through our AI-powered discovery engine, enhance our advertising tools and improve our ad delivery, targeting, and measurement capabilities, and to develop new products as well as new features for existing products. We have a history of open-sourcing in AI, including releasing our Llama foundation models as well as other models and tools, and continue to believe in the power of open source innovation. By sharing these resources, we aim to accelerate AI research, improve our products, and foster innovation across the tech community. We have not released everything we have developed historically and expect to continue training a combination of open and closed models going forward. Sales and Operations 

The majority of our marketers use our self-service ad platform to launch and manage their advertising campaigns. We also have a global sales force that is focused on attracting and retaining advertisers and providing support to them throughout the stages of the marketing cycle from pre-purchase decision-making to real-time optimizations to post-campaign analytics. We work directly with these advertisers, as well as through advertising agencies and resellers. We operate offices in more than 90 cities around the globe, the majority of which have a sales presence. We also invest in and rely on self-service tools to provide direct customer support to our users and partners. For our RL products, our sales efforts utilize third-party sales channels such as retailers, resellers, and distribution partners, and our direct-to-consumer channel, Meta.com, and several Meta stores. records.query: Meta 的廣告獲利模式與 Meta AI 在旗下 App 中扮演的角色是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 主要靠在 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger 以及第三方行動應用上展示廣告來賺錢，廣告收入是依「展示次數」或「使用者完成的行動」來計算，並在廣告實際被展示或使用者執行動作的期間確認收入；平均每則廣告的價格則是以總廣告收入除以投放的廣告數量得出，若 Meta 不是廣告的主要提供者，則以淨額方式認列收入【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311】。

- 廣告收入的核心來源是「印象」與「行動」兩種計價模式，印象型廣告在廣告被展示給使用者的合約期間確認收入，行動型廣告則在使用者完成點擊或其他約定行動時確認收入【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311】。  
- 平均每則廣告的價格（average price per ad）在 2026 年第一季較 2025 年同期上升 12%，顯示廣告單價的提升對收入有正面貢獻【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #216】。  
- 2026 年第一季的廣告收入較 2025 年同期增加 133 億美元（33%），主要因廣告展示次數上升 19% 以及平均每則廣告價格上升 12%，其中亞洲‑太平洋地區的使用者增長與廣告頻率提升是重要驅動因素【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #226】。  

Meta AI 在 Meta 各 App 中的角色則是作為跨平台的智慧助理，提供以下功能：

- Meta AI 以助理形式嵌入 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger、WhatsApp、Threads 等應用，並可在獨立的 Meta AI App、AI 眼鏡以及網路上使用，協助使用者學習、完成任務、創作內容以及連結他人【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
- 這項 AI 助理同時支援廣告相關工具，例如提升廣告定位與測量的效能、為廣告主提供更精準的受眾推薦，並參與內容排序、發現引擎以及生成式 AI 體驗的建置，提升整體平台的使用者體驗與廣告價值【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
- 在硬體層面，Meta AI 內建於 Ray‑Ban Meta、Oakley Meta 以及 Meta Ray‑Ban Display 等 AI 眼鏡，結合語音與神經帶裝置，讓使用者可透過語音或肌電信號與 AI 互動，擴大 AI 助理在沉浸式裝置中的應用範圍【META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131】。  

總結來說，Meta 的廣告獲利模式是以廣告展示次數與使用者行動為基礎，透過提升廣告單價與增加投放量來驅動收入；而 Meta AI 則在所有主要 App 以及新興硬體中提供智慧助理功能，支援內容排序、廣告工具與使用者互動，成為平台生態系統中提升使用者黏著度與廣告效益的關鍵技術【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】【META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。

Advertising. We generate substantially all of our revenue from advertising. Our advertising revenue is generated by displaying ad products on Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, and third-party mobile applications. Marketers pay for ad products either directly or through their relationships with advertising agencies or resellers, based on the number of impressions delivered or the number of actions, such as clicks, taken by users. We recognize revenue from the display of impression-based ads in the contracted period in which the impressions are delivered. Impressions are considered delivered when an ad is displayed to a user. We recognize revenue from the delivery of action-based ads in the period in which a user takes the action the marketer contracted for. The number of ads we show is subject to methodological changes as we continue to evolve our ads business and the structure of our ads products. In particular, the ads we show may vary by product (for example, our video and Reels products are not currently monetized at the same rate as our Feed or Stories products), and from time to time we increase or decrease the number or frequency of ads we show as part of our product and monetization strategies. We calculate average price per ad as total advertising revenue divided by the number of ads delivered, representing the average price paid per ad by a marketer regardless of their desired objective such as impression or action. For advertising revenue arrangements where we are not the principal, we recognize revenue on a net basis.

[META 10-Q period 202603] •Average price per ad in the first quarter of 2026 increased by 12% year-over-year. Developments in Advertising

Substantially all of our revenue is currently generated from advertising on Facebook and Instagram. We rely on targeting and measurement tools that incorporate data signals from user activity on websites and services that we do not control, as well as signals generated within our products, in order to deliver relevant and effective ads to our users. Our advertising revenue has been, and we expect will continue to be, adversely affected by reduced marketer spending as a result of limitations on our ad targeting and measurement tools arising from changes to the regulatory environment and third-party mobile operating systems and browsers. In particular, legislative and regulatory developments such as the General Data Protection Regulation, including its evolving interpretation through decisions of the Court of Justice of the European Union, ePrivacy Directive, European Digital Services Act, Digital Markets Act, and U.S. state privacy laws have impacted our ability to use data signals in our ad products, and an increasing number of laws have been introduced limiting or prohibiting the provision of our services to younger users. We expect these and other developments will have further impact in the future.

[META 10-Q period 202603] Advertising

Advertising revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 increased $13.63 billion, or 33%, compared to the same period in 2025, due to increases in ad impressions delivered and average price per ad. During the three months ended March 31, 2026, ad impressions delivered increased by 19%, year-over-year, as compared with an increase of 5% in the same period in 2025. Ad impressions delivered during the three months ended March 31, 2026 grew in all regions, especially in Asia-Pacific, which was driven by increases in users and their engagement as well as the frequency of ads shown on our products. During the three months ended March 31, 2026, the average price per ad increased by 12%, year-over-year, as compared with an increase of 10% in the same period in 2025. The increase in average price per ad in the three months ended March 31, 2026 was driven by an increase in advertising demand, which we believe is mostly due to ongoing improvements to our ad performance from our ad targeting and measurement tools, and a favorable foreign currency exchange impact. This increase was partially offset by a higher number of ad impressions delivered, especially in geographies and in products, such as Reels, that monetize at lower rates. Other factors are discussed in the section entitled "—Executive Overview of First Quarter Results." In addition, the online commerce vertical was the largest contributor to the increase in advertising revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 compared to the same period in 2025. We anticipate that future advertising revenue will be driven by a combination of price and ad impressions delivered. Other revenue

FoA other revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 increased $375 million, or 74%, compared to the same period in 2025. The increase was mostly driven by paid messaging from WhatsApp and Meta Verified subscriptions. Reality Labs

RL revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 decreased $10 million, or 2%, compared to the same period in 2025. The decrease was driven by lower Meta Quest sales, offset by an increase in sales of AI glasses. Foreign Exchange Impact on Revenue

Changes in foreign exchange rates had a favorable impact on our revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 compared to the same period in 2025. To calculate revenue on a constant currency basis, we translated revenue using the prior year's monthly exchange rates for our settlement or billing currencies other than the U.S.

records.query: Tesla 如何把自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）技術當作與競爭對手的核心差異化？
records.answer:
Tesla 把自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）技術作為與競爭對手的核心差異化，主要透過全車設計為自動駕駛、專屬 AI 與視覺系統、內部開發的推論晶片、持續的 OTA 軟體更新，以及以 FSD 為基礎的 Robotaxi 服務等多項獨特能力來實現【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31】。

- **全車自動駕駛設計**：Tesla 表示「每一輛交付的 Tesla 車輛皆為自動駕駛而設計」，這讓其產品在硬體層面即具備未來完全自動化的基礎【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31】。  
- **專屬 AI 與視覺技術**：公司使用 AI 來開發真實世界的自動駕駛應用，採用基於視覺的技術與系統，並以自家設計的推論晶片加速神經網路訓練與推論【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31】。

Intellectual Property

We place a strong emphasis on our innovative approach and proprietary designs which bring intrinsic value and uniqueness to our product portfolio. Energy Storage Products

Powerwall and Megapack are our lithium-ion battery energy storage products. Powerwall, which we sell and lease to customers, as well as through channel partners, is designed to store energy at homes or small commercial facilities. Megapack is an energy storage solution for commercial, industrial, utility and energy generation customers, multiple of which may be grouped together to form larger installations of gigawatt hours (“GWh”) or greater capacity. As AI infrastructure drives rapid load growth, Megapack helps to, among other things, increase utilization of existing generation and transmission capacity, resulting in a more efficient use of the electric grid. We also continue to develop software capabilities for remotely controlling and dispatching our energy storage systems across a wide range of markets and applications, including through our real-time energy control and optimization platforms for Megapack batteries (Autobidder) and distributed energy resources like Powerwall (Powerhub). We sell energy generation systems directly to customers and also through channel partners. Self-Driving Development and Artificial Intelligence 

We use AI to develop real-world applications, such as autonomous driving solutions and robots. Tesla 在電動車市場面臨「高度且日益加劇」的競爭，既要與傳統內燃機車型爭奪客戶，也要與大量新進入或計畫進入電動與混合動力領域的車廠競爭【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #50】。

- 這些競爭者往往擁有「更充足或更完善的資源」來投入設計、開發、生產、分銷、行銷與售後服務，且可能因地理位置或經濟環境取得成本效益，進一步壓低價格或提升產品吸引力【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66】。  
- 政府與經濟激勵措施（如本土組裝或本地供應鏈優惠）可能更有利於競爭對手，對 Tesla 的獲利與市場佔有率構成負面壓力【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66】。  
- 競爭加劇可能導致「車輛單位銷量下降、價格下調、營收短缺、失去客戶與市場份額」等風險，進而影響其營運成果與財務狀況【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66】。  

因此，Tesla 必須在產品性能、品牌、價格、能源密度與效率等多方面持續提升，以在這個「極具競爭性」的電動車市場中保持領先。

records.query: Tesla 的能源生成與儲能業務在公司整體策略中扮演什麼角色？
records.answer:
Tesla 把能源生成與儲能業務定位為與汽車事業互補、支撐整體成長的事業部門，藉由車輛技術、軟體平台與基礎建設投資來擴大清潔能源產品的規模與效益。[TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2]  

- **業務範圍**：能源生成與儲能部門負責設計、製造、安裝、銷售與租賃太陽能板、Solar Roof、Powerwall、Megapack 等太陽能與儲能產品，並提供相關服務與維修。[TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2]  
- **技術與製程連結**：公司將車輛的元件級技術套用於儲能產品，採用模組化電池系統設計以提升製造容量，同時利用自家 AI 與電力電子專長開發 Powerhub（分散式能源資源）與 Autobidder（Megapack 調度）等軟體，讓儲能系統可遠端控制與最佳化。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #32]  
- **基礎建設與 AI 投資**：為支援能源與自動駕駛/機器人業務，Tesla 正在擴建 AI 訓練叢集（Cortex、Cortex 2）與與 Samsung 合作製造先進 AI 推論晶片，這些算力提升同時服務於能源儲存與未來 Robotaxi 服務的資料需求。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #32]  
- **規模與部署**：2025 年公司部署了 46.7 GWh 的能源儲存產品，顯示該業務在公司營運中的實質貢獻與擴張速度。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #115]  
- **策略定位**：10‑K 中指出，公司以「差異化且高效管理的產品組合」為基礎，將能源生成與儲能與汽車、機器人等事業一起納入，旨在透過垂直整合供應鏈、擴大全球服務與充電基礎設施，實現盈利成長。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #115]  
- **風險說明**：雖然能源生成與儲能業務受到關稅影響較大，但公司仍將其視為長期成長機會，持續投入研發與產能擴張以抵禦政策不確定性。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #115]  

綜合上述，能源生成與儲能不僅是獨立的產品線，更是 Tesla 透過技術共享、軟體整合與基礎建設投資，支撐其清潔能源與自動駕駛長期戰略的關鍵互補業務。

Energy Storage Products

We leverage many of the component-level technologies from our vehicles in our energy storage products. By taking a modular approach to the design of battery systems, we can optimize manufacturing capacity of our energy storage products. records.query: Apple 自己在 10-K 中如何描述它在智慧型手機、PC、平板市場面臨的競爭壓力與市佔地位？
records.answer:
Apple 在 2025 年的 10‑K 中直接承認，儘管擁有完整的硬體、作業系統、軟體與服務生態系統，**在全球智慧型手機、個人電腦（PC）與平板電腦市場仍只有少數（minority）市佔**，且面臨「激烈」的競爭壓力【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。

- **競爭壓力**：Apple 指出其產品與服務面臨來自資金、行銷、分銷與技術資源都相當充足的競爭者，這些對手擁有「大型硬體、軟體與服務產品線」以及「龐大的客戶基礎」【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。競爭者常透過「激進的降價」與「低成本結構」來爭奪市場，甚至在某些情況下「以幾乎不賺錢甚至虧損的方式」提供產品與服務，對 Apple 的毛利率造成下行壓力【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。此外，競爭者也會「模仿 Apple 的產品功能與應用」以及「整合零件與服務」以提供類似的整體解決方案【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。

- **市場特性**：Apple 說明其所處的市場「價格競爭激烈、毛利率承壓、產品性能持續提升、消費者與企業對價格敏感」，且產品生命週期短、產業標準快速演變，競爭者常以「 aggressive pricing」與「very low cost structures」來爭奪市場份額【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #23】。

- **市佔情形**：在上述三大主要硬體類別（智慧型手機、PC、平板）中，Apple 只佔「少數」的全球市場份額，暗示其相對於競爭對手的規模較小【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。

總結來說，Apple 在 10‑K 中描述自己在智慧型手機、PC 與平板市場的競爭環境為「高度激烈且資源充足的對手」主導，且公司僅持有「少數」的市場佔有率。

records.query: Apple 的第三方開發者生態系相對於 Android、Windows 等平台的黏著度是如何建立的？
records.answer:
Apple 透過龐大的活躍裝置基數、可觀的硬體與服務營收機會，以及完整的平台與服務生態，讓第三方開發者感受到相較於 Android、Windows 等競爭平台的明顯利益，從而提升黏著度。  

- Apple 的開發者會根據「市場地位、預期營收、未來成長與開發成本」來評估在 Apple 平台上投入的價值，這些因素直接影響他們對 Apple 生態系的黏著度【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。  
- 公司的活躍裝置基數已突破「約十億付費用戶」的全新高，遍及所有產品類別與地域，為開發者提供了極大的使用者觸及面【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。  
- iPhone 單季營收達 **570 億美元**（佔總營收 51%），服務部門創下 **310 億美元** 的高毛利收入（佔總營收 28%），這兩大收入來源為開發者的 App、廣告、雲端服務等提供了豐厚的商機【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。  
- Apple 透過 App Store、iCloud、Apple Pay、Apple Music、Apple TV+ 等多元平台與訂閱服務，形成「硬體‑軟體‑服務」的完整生態，讓開發者的應用能在多個裝置與服務間互通，提升使用者黏著度與開發者依賴度【AAPL_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 為了保持技術領先與平台吸引力，Apple 在最近一季將研發支出提升 **34%**，達 **114 億美元**，主要投入 AI 基礎建設與相關基礎設施，進一步增強開發者在 AI、機器學習等新興領域的開發環境【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。  
- 同時，10‑K 也指出 Apple 在全球智慧手機、個人電腦、平板與穿戴裝置的市場佔有率相對較低，可能削弱開發者的投入意願，因而必須依賴其整體裝置基數來抵消這一劣勢【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。  

綜合以上，Apple 透過「大規模活躍用戶基礎」＋「高營收與利潤的硬體/服務組合」＋「多元且互補的平台服務」＋「持續的研發與 AI 投入」來提升第三方開發者對其平台的黏著度，儘管在某些硬體領域的市佔率較低，仍藉整體生態的規模與收益潛力與 Android、Windows 等競爭平台形成差異化。

records.query: Microsoft More Personal Computing 部門最新一季營收表現如何？哪些因素互相抵銷？
records.answer:
Microsoft’s More Personal Computing segment saw revenue dip about 1 % to **132 億美元** in the three‑months ended March 31 2026 versus 134 億美元 a year earlier【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #104】.  

The revenue decline was partially offset by a **10 % drop in cost of revenue** (to 55 億美元 from 61 億美元)【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #104】, which helped improve profitability. At the same time, **operating expenses rose 7 %** (to 40 億美元 from 38 億美元)【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #104】, tempering the benefit from lower costs. The net effect was a **4 % increase in operating income** for the segment (to 37 億美元 from 35 億美元)【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #104】.  

Thus, the modest revenue contraction was counterbalanced by lower cost of revenue, while higher operating expenses limited the upside, resulting in a small operating‑income gain.

records.query: Amazon AWS 部門最新一季營業利益成長的主要驅動因素是什麼？
records.answer:
Amazon AWS 部門在最新一季（2026 年第一季）營業利益的成長主要是因為客戶使用量大幅提升，帶動銷售顯著增加【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #75】。  

- AWS 的營業利益從 2025 年第一季的 **115.47 億美元** 增至 2026 年第一季的 **141.61 億美元**，增幅約 **26.14 億美元**【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #79】。  
- 這一增長「主要是因為銷售增加」，而銷售的提升「主要反映了客戶使用量的增加」【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #75】。  
- 同時，營業利益的提升被「技術與基礎設施支出」所部分抵銷，因為 AWS 為支撐業務成長而加大了基礎設施投資【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #79】。  
- 另外，長期客戶合約導致的「定價變動」也對銷售增長形成了部分抵消【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #75】。  
- 匯率變動對 AWS 營業利益產生了負面影響，2026 年第一季因匯率變動「減少了 3.39 億美元」【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #79】。  

綜合來說，客戶使用量的顯著提升是 AWS 營業利益增長的核心驅動因素，儘管技術基礎設施投入、定價調整以及匯率不利影響部分抵消了這一增長。

records.query: Google 收購 Wiz 花了多少錢？這如何影響 Google Cloud 部門？
records.answer:
Google 完成收購 Wiz 的最終成交金額為 **295 億美元**，此金額已在合併財務報表中列入 Google Cloud 部門的資產與負債項目中【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #94】。  

- **成交金額與分配**：在完成收購後，Google 將購買價格分配至無形資產 83 億美元、商譽 227.05 億美元，並假設了淨負債 $(1,538) million，合計 294.67 億美元（即 295 億美元）【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #94】。  
- **協議金額**：在 2025 年的最終協議中，Alphabet 曾同意以 **320 億美元**（含調整）收購 Wiz，該金額屬於簽約時的原始估值【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #296】。  
- **對 Google Cloud 的影響**：收購完成後，Wiz 的財務結果被納入 Google Cloud 部門的合併財務報表，並在該部門記錄了上述商譽與無形資產【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #94】。商譽主要反映預期的協同效應，且已在 Google Cloud 部門列示，顯示此交易將提升雲端在多雲與 AI 驅動的安全服務能力【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #94】。  

因此，Google 為 Wiz 支付了 295 億美元（協議時的估值為 320 億美元），並將相關資產與商譽計入 Google Cloud，增強其在多雲與 AI 安全領域的產品與服務基礎。

In fiscal year 2025, we launched the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture, a full set of data center scale infrastructure that includes GPUs, CPUs, DPUs, interconnects, switch chips and systems, and networking adapters. Blackwell excels at processing cutting edge generative AI and accelerated computing workloads with market leading performance and efficiency. Offered in a number of configurations, for customers across industries and a diverse set of AI and accelerated computing use cases. In fiscal year 2026, we unveiled the NVIDIA Rubin platform, which is expected to commence production shipments in the second half of fiscal year 2027. [NVDA 10-K period 2026] NVIDIA pioneered accelerated computing to help solve the most challenging computational problems. NVIDIA is now a data center scale AI infrastructure company reshaping all industries. Our technology stack includes the foundational NVIDIA CUDA development platform that runs on all NVIDIA GPUs, as well as hundreds of domain-specific software libraries, frameworks, algorithms, software development kits, or SDKs, and application programming interfaces, or APIs. This deep and broad software stack accelerates the performance and facilitates the deployment of NVIDIA accelerated computing for computationally intensive workloads such as artificial intelligence, or AI, model training and inference, data analytics, scientific computing, robotics, and 3D graphics, with vertical-specific optimizations to address industries ranging from healthcare and telecom to automotive and manufacturing. Introduced with the Blackwell architecture, our data-center-scale offerings feature extreme co-design where the infrastructure’s chips, networking, systems, software, and algorithms are holistically architected and optimized to maximize performance and scale. Hundreds of thousands of GPUs can be interconnected to function as a single giant computer. This type of data center architecture and scale is needed for the development and deployment of modern AI and accelerated computing applications. The GPU was initially used to simulate human imagination, enabling the virtual worlds of video games and films. records.query: 為什麼大家做 AI 都要靠 NVIDIA 的技術，別家學不來？
records.answer:
大家在做 AI 幾乎都必須依賴 NVIDIA，因為它提供了從硬體到軟體、從開發工具到完整生態系統的全套加速平台，使得 AI 訓練與推論在效能、規模與成本上遠超其他供應商【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。

**主要原因如下**  

1. **統一的硬體與軟體堆疊** – NVIDIA 把 GPU、CPU（Grace）與 DPU 結合成資料中心級別的完整算力平台，並以 CUDA 為基礎的開發環境、數百個領域專屬的軟體庫、框架與 API，讓任何 AI 工作負載都能直接在同一套架構上執行【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  

2. **AI‑專屬功能與持續創新** – 其 GPU 內建 Tensor Core，專為深度學習設計；自 2017 年首代 Tensor Core 以來持續加入 AI‑specific 特性；2024 年推出的 Blackwell 架構以及 2026 年的 Blackwell Ultra 平台，提供「千兆參數」即時推論與更高的 token 吞吐量，顯著提升效能並降低每個 token 的成本【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21】【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26】。  

3. **完整的企業級軟體套件** – NVIDIA AI Enterprise 包含 NIM（提升 token 吞吐量）、NeMo（模型微調與安全）與 AI Blueprints（即用型 AI 模板），讓企業能快速部署生成式與代理式 AI 應用，降低開發門檻【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  

4. **龐大的開發者與合作夥伴生態** – 超過 750 萬開發者使用 CUDA 及其他工具，NVIDIA 透過大學、初創公司與 Inception 計畫培育生態系；所有主要雲端服務供應商、AI 模型製造商與企業均依賴其平台，形成「網路效應」使得其他公司難以自行重建同等規模的生態【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  

5. **在全球超級電腦市場的主導地位** – NVIDIA 的 GPU（含網路與資料處理）支撐了全球 TOP500 超級電腦的超過 78%，其中 9 台位列 Green500 前十，證明其在高效能計算與 AI 訓練領域的領先優勢【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #22】。  

6. **跨產業的深度滲透** – 從資料分析、科學計算、機器人、醫療、金融到自動駕駛，NVIDIA 的平台已被廣泛應用於多個「數十億美元」的終端市場，形成多元收入來源與持續需求【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  

綜合以上硬體領先、軟體完整、開發者生態與市場滲透四大優勢，其他公司若想自行打造同等規模與效能的 AI 基礎設施，必須在研發、資本與合作網路上投入巨額資源，因而難以在短期內追趕 NVIDIA 的領先地位。

records.query: 微軟是怎麼把 AI 塞進 Office 那些軟體裡的？
records.answer:
Microsoft 把 AI 直接嵌入 Office 的方式是透過 **Microsoft 365 Copilot** 以及一系列 AI‑enabled 工具、功能與「agentic」情境，將生成式 AI 助手內建於 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 等 Office 應用，讓使用者在這些程式內即時取得 AI 建議與自動化功能【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  

- **Copilot 作為 Microsoft 365 產品的一部份**，與 Office、Windows、Enterprise Mobility + Security 等服務共同組成「AI‑powered business and productivity solutions platform」，因此 AI 功能是隨雲端訂閱一起交付，而非額外的外掛【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  
- **在財報層面**，Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端收入的計算已包括 Microsoft 365 Copilot，顯示 Copilot 已成為 Microsoft 365 商業雲端服務的核心收入項目【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #101】。  
- **AI 使用量的提升** 正在推動成本與毛利的變化；公司指出毛利率略為下降，主要是因為「持續的 AI 基礎建設投資與 AI 產品使用量增加」【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #103】。這些投資包括支援 Copilot 及其他 AI 服務的運算資源。  
- **為了強化這些 AI 服務**，Microsoft 亦在 2026 年宣布開發七個自建的 AI 模型，聚焦於微調（fine‑tuning）與成本最佳化，以減少對外部前沿實驗室的依賴，為其雲端與 Office AI 功能提供底層模型支撐【MSFT_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。  

總結來說，Microsoft 透過將 Copilot 及其他 AI‑enabled 功能直接整合進 Microsoft 365（即 Office）雲端服務，並持續投入自建 AI 模型與基礎設施，讓 AI 成為 Office 軟體內部的即時助理與自動化引擎。

Asked about investor concerns over Microsoft concentration, Jiang said AvePoint has operated in the Microsoft ecosystem for more than 20 years but does not depend on Microsoft as a reseller. He said Microsoft does not resell AvePoint’s products, and AvePoint helps customers complete “last mile” adoption of workloads such as Purview, E5 and Copilot. Jiang said AvePoint is also active in the Google, Salesforce and AWS ecosystems as customers become increasingly multi-cloud. He said AvePoint is complementary to hyperscalers because it helps customers manage different license types and workloads across multiple platforms. On Microsoft 365 backup, Jiang said Microsoft Office Cloud has roughly 400 million to 500 million user seats, while AvePoint covers “tens of millions” of seats and is not yet at 100 million. He said the company still sees room for growth, while also incorporating Microsoft’s Backup Express snapshot capability into its own backup stack. Jiang said many customers use a mix of license levels, noting that E5 penetration remains below 20% and Copilot penetration is about 5%, according to his comments. He said AvePoint helps customers maximize existing investments rather than pushing them toward the highest-cost licenses. Multi-Cloud Expansion and SaaS Model
Jiang said AvePoint expects non-Microsoft revenue to rise to more than 30% of its mix as the company pursues its goal of reaching $1 billion in annual recurring revenue. He said non-Microsoft revenue is currently less than 10%. He said the company already has product coverage across ecosystems including Google, Salesforce, Atlassian, ServiceNow and AWS, but go-to-market development takes time because each ecosystem has different partners and channels. Jiang also highlighted AvePoint’s SaaS-heavy model. He said 88% of revenue is recurring and that AvePoint runs on hyperscaler infrastructure across GCP, Azure, AWS and U.S. government data centers. He said hyperscaler contracts help shield AvePoint from hardware supply-chain shocks and pricing volatility. “We are a true SaaS company that’s asset light,” Jiang said. Control Suite and AgentPulse
Kessinger asked Jiang to clarify AvePoint’s role in governance and security. Jiang said the company’s roots in enterprise content management mean it manages the lifecycle of unstructured data, from ingestion, migration, classification and tagging to backup, ransomware recovery and governance. Jiang said these capabilities are increasingly important in the AI era because AI can accelerate access and data-management problems. He said AvePoint competes across areas that had previously been separate, including migration, backup, governance and data security posture management. Jiang also discussed AvePoint AgentPulse, which he said became generally available in the first quarter after a preview late last year. He said AgentPulse helps customers discover AI agents running across cloud environments such as Gemini and Copilot, control what systems and data they can access, monitor token consumption and shut agents down when needed. Jiang said AgentPulse is monetized through AvePoint’s “best” Control bundle and is helping increase Control deal sizes. He said Control represents about 40% of the company’s pipeline, compared with 26% of blended revenue contribution last year, while resiliency remains close to 60%. records.answer:
Amazon 已經在 AI 領域投入數十億美元：在 2026 Q1 直接投資 **15 億美元** 購買 OpenAI 的 Series C 優先股，並承諾在未來可再投入 **35 億美元**（Commitment Amount）；在 2026 3 月 31 日之後又投入 **5 億美元** 購買 Anthropic 的非投票優先股，同時與兩家公司簽署了 AWS 雲端服務與合作協議【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40】。  

- **OpenAI**：2026 Q1 Amazon 投資 **15 億美元** 於 OpenAI Series C Preferred Stock，並透過「Letter Agreement」承諾最多再購買 **35 億美元** 的股份；此外，Amazon 與 OpenAI 簽訂了商業安排，主要提供 AWS 雲端服務與 AWS 晶片，並共同合作將 OpenAI 模型服務上架至 AWS 平台【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40】【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #41】。  
- **Anthropic**：截至 2025 12 月 31 日與 2026 3 月 31 日，Amazon 持有的非投票優先股（主要是 Anthropic）帳面價值分別為 **16.2 億美元** 和 **48.1 億美元**，顯示其在 Anthropic 的持股規模相當大【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #41】；在 2026 3 月 31 日之後，Amazon 追加投資 **5 億美元** 於 Anthropic 的非投票優先股【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40】。  
- **相關商業與融資安排**：Amazon 為 Anthropic 設立最高 **20 億美元** 的融資設施（30 個月內於 IPO 或直接上市後可提取），並保留 **5 億美元** 的選擇權以參與未來的股權融資【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40】。  

總結來說，Amazon 正透過大額股權投資與 AWS 服務合作，與 **OpenAI** 以及 **Anthropic** 兩家領先的生成式 AI 公司緊密結盟，持續擴大其在生成式 AI 生態系統中的資本與技術布局。

records.query: Meta 搞的那些 VR 眼鏡跟 AI，到底想往哪個方向發展？
records.answer:
Meta 正在把 VR 眼鏡與 AI 結合，打造以沉浸式現實與智能助理為核心的下一代計算平台，並以此推動其元宇宙與超級智慧願景【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131】。

- **VR 硬體與內容生態**：Meta 以 Meta Quest 系列為主要 VR 頭盔，配合 Meta Horizon Store 的軟體與內容，提供遊戲、健身、娛樂等多元社交體驗，並透過「passthrough」技術讓使用者在沉浸同時仍能感知現實世界【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131】。  
- **AI 眼鏡與穿戴**：Meta 的 AI 眼鏡包括 Ray‑Ban Meta、Oakley Meta（內建 Meta AI 對話助理與免手操作功能），2024 年推出的 Orion 原型（真實 AR 眼鏡，具業界領先的視野與佩戴舒適度），以及 2025 年的 Meta Ray‑Ban Display（鏡片內嵌顯示器）與配套的 Meta Neural Band（利用肌電訊號控制眼鏡）【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131】。  
- **AI 技術與基礎設施**：Meta 正在大幅投資生成式 AI、超級智慧以及 AI 驅動的內容推薦引擎（AI‑powered discovery engine），以提升廣告工具、內容發現與產品功能，同時預計計算需求將持續擴大，需加強自建與第三方資料中心的基礎設施【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】。  
- **產品與平台願景**：Meta 的使命是「打造未來的人類連結與相應技術」，其長期願景是將 2D 螢幕之外的沉浸式 AR/VR 體驗作為下一代計算平台，並以 AI 為核心驅動力，從內容排序、廣告投放到新產品開發皆納入 AI 超級智慧的藍圖【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
- **市場與用戶策略**：Meta 透過 AI‑powered discovery engine 已看到用戶參與度與變現提升，並持續在 Reels、Feed 等產品中嵌入 AI 功能，以對抗年輕族群的競爭壓力，進一步支撐其沉浸式與 AI 產品的成長【META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #209】。  

綜合以上，Meta 的發展方向是：**以 AI 為核心的沉浸式硬體（VR/AR 眼鏡）結合軟體生態，打造新一代計算平台，同時加速基礎設施與超級智慧的投資，以支撐未來的內容、廣告與新產品創新**。

contexts: [META 10-K period 2025] In the near term, we are continuing to develop products and experiences that help people feel connected, anytime, anywhere. Our current product offerings in VR include our Meta Quest devices, as well as software and content available through the Meta Horizon Store, which enable a range of social experiences that allow people to defy physical distance while engaging in gaming, fitness, entertainment, and more. To drive greater adoption and acceptance of VR we have introduced passthrough capabilities, which allow users to experience the immersion and presence of VR while still being grounded in the physical world, through our Meta Quest devices. Our wearables efforts include our AI glasses and long-term AR initiatives. Our current AI glasses include the Ray-Ban Meta and Oakley Meta glasses, which feature Meta AI, our advanced conversational assistant, as well as other features such as hands-free interaction. As we continue our long-term efforts to bring AR glasses to market, in 2024 we also unveiled our Orion prototype, a pair of true AR glasses that overlay content on top of the physical world. It does this with an industry-leading field of view and in glasses form factor for comfortable wear. In 2025, we introduced Meta Ray-Ban Display, which combines our AI glasses with an integrated display built into the lens. It comes with the Meta Neural Band, which is a wrist-worn wearable device that uses electromyography to let people control their AI glasses using neuromuscular signals. In general, our Reality Labs efforts include shorter-term projects developing specific products and services to go to market, as well as longer-term research and development projects.

[META 10-K period 2025] Our product development philosophy centers on continuous innovation in creating and improving products that are social by design, which means that our products are designed to place people and their social interactions at the core of the product experience. Historically, the increases in our computing needs have been driven by growth in our user base as well as engagement with products like video and VR. Our increased efforts toward building frontier AI models have driven a significant further expansion in our computing needs and we expect our computing needs to continue to expand as a result. We have designed and built our own data centers and key portions of our technical infrastructure, and a substantial portion of our technical infrastructure is also provided by third parties. Our ability to provide and continue to innovate our products and services depends on the continued availability of components, power, and network capacity. We make significant investments in technology both to improve our existing products and services and to develop new ones, as well as for our marketers and developers. We are also investing in protecting the security, privacy, and integrity of our platform by investing in both people and technology to strengthen our systems against abuse. Across all of these efforts, we are making significant investments in AI initiatives, including generative AI and superintelligence, to, among other things, recommend relevant content across our products through our AI-powered discovery engine, enhance our advertising tools and improve our ad delivery, targeting, and measurement capabilities, and to develop new products as well as new features for existing products. We have a history of open-sourcing in AI, including releasing our Llama foundation models as well as other models and tools, and continue to believe in the power of open source innovation. By sharing these resources, we aim to accelerate AI research, improve our products, and foster innovation across the tech community. We have not released everything we have developed historically and expect to continue training a combination of open and closed models going forward. Sales and Operations 

The majority of our marketers use our self-service ad platform to launch and manage their advertising campaigns. We also have a global sales force that is focused on attracting and retaining advertisers and providing support to them throughout the stages of the marketing cycle from pre-purchase decision-making to real-time optimizations to post-campaign analytics. We work directly with these advertisers, as well as through advertising agencies and resellers. We operate offices in more than 90 cities around the globe, the majority of which have a sales presence. We also invest in and rely on self-service tools to provide direct customer support to our users and partners. For our RL products, our sales efforts utilize third-party sales channels such as retailers, resellers, and distribution partners, and our direct-to-consumer channel, Meta.com, and several Meta stores. These efforts are focused on driving consumer and enterprise sales and adoption of our Meta Quest portfolio of products and AI glasses. 8


Marketing

Historically, our communities have generally grown organically with people inviting their friends to connect with them, supported by internal efforts to stimulate awareness and interest. In addition, we have invested and will continue to invest in marketing our products and services to grow our brand and help build community around the world. Intellectual Property

[META 10-K period 2025] Item 1.Business 

Overview

Our mission is to build the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible. Our products enable people to connect and share through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality (VR) headsets, and AI glasses. We are innovating in artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to build transformative experiences and capabilities across our Family of Apps and new platforms, and to advance our vision to deliver personal superintelligence for everyone. We build technology that helps people connect and share, find and build communities, and grow businesses. We also help people discover and learn about what is going on in the world around them, enable people to share their experiences, ideas, photos, videos, and other content with audiences ranging from their closest family members and friends to the public at large, and stay connected everywhere by accessing our products. Meta is moving our offerings beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next computing platform. Our vision does not center on any single product, but rather an entire ecosystem of experiences, devices, and new technologies powered by AI. While the metaverse is in the very early stages of its development, we believe it will become the next computing platform and the future of social interaction. Across our work, we are innovating to build new experiences that help make our platform more social, useful, and immersive. Our AI investments support initiatives across our products and services, helping power the systems that rank content in our apps, our discovery engine that recommends relevant content, the tools advertisers use to reach customers, the development of new generative AI experiences, and the tools that make our product development more efficient and productive. We are also working to develop the next generation of AI models and advance our vision to build superintelligence, which we define as AI that surpasses human intelligence. Although it is inherently difficult to predict when superintelligence may be achieved, we are investing now because we believe this has the potential to begin a new era of individual empowerment, where people can direct superintelligence towards what they value in their own lives. Family of Apps Products

•Facebook. Facebook helps give people the power to build community and bring the world closer together. It's a place for people to share life's moments and discuss what's happening, nurture and build relationships, discover and connect to people with shared interests, and create economic opportunity. They can do this through Feed, Reels, Stories, Groups, Marketplace, and more. •Instagram. Instagram brings people closer to the people and things they love. Instagram Feed, Stories, Reels, Live, and messaging are places where people and creators can connect and express themselves through photos, video, and private messaging, and discover and shop from their favorite businesses. •Messenger. Messenger is a simple yet powerful messaging application for people to connect with friends, family, communities, and businesses across platforms and devices through text, audio, and video calls. •Meta AI. Meta AI is an assistant that's available across our apps, as a stand-alone app, on our AI glasses, and on the web. It's designed to help people learn, get things done, create content, and connect with others to make the most of every moment.

[META 10-Q period 202509] In addition, competitive products and services have reduced some users' engagement with our products and services. We are investing in Reels and in AI initiatives across our products, including our AI-powered discovery engine to recommend relevant content, which we have already seen results in improved user engagement and monetization of our products. However, we continue to face competition from other products and services within certain demographics, in particular younger users. In addition, while Reels is growing in usage, it monetizes at a lower rate than our Feed and Stories products and we expect it will continue to monetize at a lower rate for the foreseeable future. We also have seen fluctuations and declines in the size of our active user base in one or more regions from time to time due to geopolitical conditions, which have adversely affected our user growth and engagement. These trends have adversely affected our advertising revenue and we expect will continue to adversely affect our advertising revenue in the foreseeable future. Although we regularly evaluate a variety of sources to understand trends in our advertising revenue, we do not have perfect visibility into the factors driving advertiser spending decisions and our assessments involve complex judgments about what is driving advertising decisions across a large and diversified advertiser base across the globe. Trends impacting advertising spend are also dynamic and interrelated. As a result, it is difficult to identify with precision which advertiser spending decisions are attributable to which trends, and we are unable to quantify the exact impact that each trend had on our advertising revenue during the periods presented. 34


Investment Philosophy

We remain focused on operating efficiently while investing in significant opportunities. In the nine months ended September 30, 2025, 83% of our total costs and expenses were recognized in FoA and 17% were recognized in RL. Our FoA investments include expenses relating to headcount, data centers, and technical infrastructure as part of our efforts to develop our apps and our advertising services. These efforts include significant investments in AI initiatives, including generative AI and superintelligence, to, among other things, recommend relevant content across our products, enhance our advertising tools, develop new products, and develop new features for existing products. In particular, we expect our AI initiatives will require significantly increased investment in infrastructure. We are also making significant investments in our metaverse and wearables efforts, including developing virtual, augmented, and mixed reality devices, software for social platforms, neural interfaces, and other foundational technologies. Our RL investments include expenses relating to technology development across these efforts.

records.answer:
Tesla 的自動駕駛被視為較其他車廠更具優勢，因為它從感測器、視覺演算法到 AI 加速晶片全部自行研發，並在每一輛交付的車上預裝可支援完全自動駕駛的硬體與軟體，透過 OTA 方式持續升級，這些「端到端」的自研能力是公司自認能與競爭對手區隔的關鍵。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]

- **全車設計為自動駕駛**：Tesla 表示「每一台今天交付的 Tesla 車輛皆為設計可支援自動駕駛」​，且公司相信其 AI 能力與進步使其在市場上與競爭者不同​。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]  
- **視覺為主的感測與演算法**：Tesla 使用「基於視覺的技術、系統與軟體」來訓練人工神經網路，這是其自動駕駛核心​。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]  
- **自家設計的 AI 推論晶片**：這些神經網路由「自行設計的推論晶片」加速，屬於完全內部開發的硬體解決方案​。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]  
- **軟體內部開發與 OTA 更新**：Tesla 幾乎全部車內軟體（包括使用者介面）都是自行開發，並透過「空中無線更新」定期升級功能與安全性​。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]  
- **完整的 AI 生態系統**：除了車載 AI，Tesla 亦在 Robotaxi 服務與 FSD（Supervised）訂閱等軟體驅動的商業模式上布局，利用同一套 AI 平台擴展服務收入​。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]  

綜合以上，Tesla 以全車硬體、視覺演算法、自研 AI 晶片與 OTA 軟體更新的端到端整合，形成了相較於仍依賴外部供應商或較為分散的競爭對手更具競爭力的自動駕駛優勢。

records.answer:
Apple does not explicitly say in the provided materials that it is **not** the market‑share leader in smartphones.  

- The news summary notes that iPhone revenue “jumped 22 % to 570 億美元” and that the iPhone 17 lineup saw “extraordinary” demand, but it never includes a statement from Apple conceding a loss of leadership in the handset market【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】.  
- The Q2 2026 Form 10‑Q shows iPhone net sales rising 22 % year‑over‑year to 569.94 億美元, again highlighting growth rather than any admission of falling behind competitors【AAPL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #65】.  
- The 2025 Form 10‑K and other risk disclosures discuss the need to “remain competitive” and “manage frequent introductions” amid “highly volatile and competitive” markets, but they do not contain a direct acknowledgment that Apple is not the smartphone market leader【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #104】.  

Because none of the referenced documents contain a statement where Apple admits it is not the market‑share leader in the mobile phone sector, the answer is that such an admission is **not present** in the supplied materials.

[AAPL] The Board authorized another $100 billion buyback and raised the dividend 4%. Search volume from financial pros spiked, with Apple drawing nearly 21,000 searches in the past month, per our TrackStar data, more than its next four hardware peers combined. So is the run sustainable, or did Apple just front-load demand ahead of more tariff drama? Apple’s Business
Apple needs no introduction, but the company’s transformation does. What was once a hardware story is now a hybrid: $80.2 billion in product sales last quarter alongside $31.0 billion in high-margin services. The installed base of active devices hit another all-time high across every product category and every geography. Apple sells iPhones, Macs, iPads, wearables, and a growing suite of subscription services to roughly a billion paying users globally. Apple segments its business into the following areas:
iPhone (51% of total revenues)
– Flagship smartphone line, recently expanded with the iPhone 17 lineup and a new iPhone 17e
Services (28% of total revenues)
– App Store, advertising, iCloud, Apple Music, Apple TV+, and payment services
Mac (8% of total revenues)
– Laptops and desktops, including the newly launched MacBook Neo
Wearables, Home & Accessories (7% of total revenues)
– AirPods, Apple Watch, Vision Pro, and accessories
iPad (6% of total revenues)
– Tablet lineup, recently refreshed with the M4-powered iPad Air
iPhone revenue jumped 22% to $57.0 billion, the standout of the quarter. Services climbed 16% to a record $31.0 billion, propelled by advertising, App Store, and cloud. Greater China rebounded sharply, with renminbi strength adding fuel. Tim Cook called demand for the iPhone 17 lineup “extraordinary.”
On the strategic front, Apple is going all-in on AI infrastructure. R&D spending jumped 34% year-over-year to $11.4 billion last quarter, citing higher infrastructure costs. Tariff overhang remains real but manageable. A February Supreme Court ruling struck down certain tariffs, and Apple is applying for refunds. Gains and losses arising from amounts that are included in the assessment of cash flow hedge effectiveness are initially deferred in accumulated other comprehensive income/(loss) and subsequently reclassified into earnings when the hedged transaction affects earnings, and in the same line item in the Consolidated Statements of Operations. Gains and losses arising from amounts that are included in the assessment of fair value hedge effectiveness are recognized in the Consolidated Statements of Operations line item to which the hedge relates along with offsetting losses and gains related to the change in value of the hedged item. For derivative instruments designated as cash flow and fair value hedges, amounts excluded from the assessment of hedge effectiveness are recognized on a straight-line basis over the life of the hedge in the Consolidated Statements of Operations line item to which the hedge relates. Changes in the fair value of amounts excluded from the assessment of hedge effectiveness are recognized in other comprehensive income/(loss). Gains and losses arising from changes in the fair values of derivative instruments that are not designated as accounting hedges are recognized in the Consolidated Statements of Operations. The Company classifies cash flows related to derivative instruments in the same section of the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows as the items being hedged, which are generally classified as operating activities. Foreign Exchange Rate Risk

To protect gross margins from fluctuations in foreign exchange rates, the Company may use forwards, options or other instruments, and may designate these instruments as cash flow hedges. The Company generally hedges portions of its forecasted foreign currency exposure associated with revenue and inventory purchases, typically for up to 12 months. To protect the Company’s foreign currency–denominated term debt or marketable securities from fluctuations in foreign exchange rates, the Company may use forwards, cross-currency swaps or other instruments. The Company designates these instruments as either cash flow or fair value hedges. As of September 27, 2025, the maximum length of time over which the Company is hedging its exposure to the variability in future cash flows for term debt–related foreign currency transactions is 17 years. The Company may also use derivative instruments that are not designated as accounting hedges to protect gross margins from certain fluctuations in foreign exchange rates, as well as to offset a portion of the foreign currency gains and losses generated by the remeasurement of certain assets and liabilities denominated in non-functional currencies. Interest Rate Risk

To protect the Company’s term debt or marketable securities from fluctuations in interest rates, the Company may use interest rate swaps, options or other instruments. The Company designates these instruments as either cash flow or fair value hedges.

in the prior quarter. He added that cost of revenues decreased by

primarily related to decommissioning mining hardware, plus
